title: United Petroleum Pty Ltd - proposed acquisition of seven Victorian petrol retail sites from Freedom Fuels Australia Pty Ltd

timeline.event: ACCC commenced review under the Merger Review Process Guidelines.
Closing date for submissions from interested parties.
Former proposed decision date of 1 December 2011 delayed to allow for provision of outstanding information.
ACCC received further information from the merger parties. ACCC timeline recommenced.
ACCC announced it would not oppose the proposed acquisition.

body_sections.Summary: United Petroleum Pty Ltd proposed to acquire the following petrol retail sites from Freedom Fuels Australia Pty Ltd - Kew, Mt Waverley, Churchill, Maffra, Newborough, Tyers and San Remo. Initially, four other Freedom Fuel sites were included as part of this review, namely Warragul, Morwell, Traralgon and Sale. At the time of making its decision with respect to this matter, the ACCC had not yet made a decision in relation to those sites and is continuing to review United's proposed acquisition of those sites.  See United/ Freedom sites
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the competitive effects of the proposed acquisition in the context of local retail markets for the supply of petrol, diesel and LPG.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC formed the view that United's proposed acquisition of Freedom's sites in Kew, Mt Waverley, Churchill, Maffra, Newborough, Tyers and San Remo was unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets because United is not currently operating in any of the local markets in which the Freedom sites are located.
